notes.title: Stage 3 Save Patch
notes.content: Resolved issue in Stage 3 where player inventory, purchases, and progress was not saving. The game should reflect previous saves, and future saves should be successful going forward.

notes.title: Settings Screen Update
notes.content:
Based on reviewer feedback, we also implemented 
1.) An exit game button
2.) Keyboard shortcuts to skip stages or skip to the idle game portion

notes.title: Stage 3 Bug Patch
notes.content: Some players encountered an error where the game restarts itself at Stage 3. We have disabled code which will hopefully stop this issue while we work on resolving it, so players can experience Stage 3.
